plain_language_zh: 本合同定义答案怎么来、错在哪一层、论文表上的每个数怎么算。输入是 S0-03 两段封存之后的召回与分配、旧记忆和当前帧的私有实例真值；输出是逐色块与逐实体的标签、三分解计数、七项指标与 house 级配对 bootstrap。例如一个色块的主导实例是旧杯子、旧杯子实体也在召回里、学生却把它分到新建列，这一例记为 amortization error 而不是 recall miss。它不生成候选、不改召回、不进入部署推理，也不定义对照臂参数（S0-05）。合同里的每一个布尔值都被校验器绑定：翻转、缺失或新增任何一条都会被拒。

depends_on.s0_03_interface_zh: 只依赖 S0-03 产物的数据形状：召回字典（fragment_id → 实体 ID 列表，五臂共享、与实体状态无关）、分配字典（值是 entity_id 或 birth:<fragment_id>）、阶段 B 的存在候选列表、以及阶段 A 与阶段 B 两段封存摘要。不导入 S0-03 的任何函数。关联特征里没有 supported_by_agrees，只有 support_height_difference_m；本阶段评价器不读任何表面 ID。

private_gate.plain_language_zh: teacher 与评价器只能拿着 S0-03 的放行回执打开私有数据，回执必须同时写明阶段 A（召回与关联/新建特征）和阶段 B（分配回执与存在特征，带阶段 A 摘要）两段封存摘要；缺任一段、链条断裂或指向另一帧都不发回执。teacher 本身不打开任何文件。训练时喂给存在特征的分配来自当前策略或登记的规则臂，teacher 不产生也不替换分配。teacher 不增删、不重排召回。

private_truth_inputs.fragment_instance: per fragment: {overlap: {private object key: share of the fragment's pixels on that instance}, pixel_count: int}; the unlisted remainder is background; pixel_count is the public mask size and is only used to rank same-frame duplicates
private_truth_inputs.evidence_instance: per (frame_digest|fragment_id) of every past evidence item: private object key or null
private_truth_inputs.object_state: per private object key: {present: bool, centroid_m: [x,y,z] when present}
private_truth_inputs.truth_objects: per private object key in the truth node scope this frame: {present: bool, aabb_min_m, aabb_max_m, centroid_m when present}

truth_box_source.initial_box_read_from: one reload of the house in the frozen simulator per episode, metadata.objects[].axisAlignedBoundingBox and rotation at the house-authored agent pose before any action (S1-04 object geometry table, private plane)
truth_box_source.per_frame_box: the initial box translated by object_poses[t] minus the initial position, expressed in the episode frame (world coordinates minus the observation-0 camera position)
truth_box_source.rotation_assumption: move and add are executed by PlaceObjectAtPoint, which keeps the object rotation; physics settle after placement is the registered residual
truth_box_source.residual_reported_by: the S1-04 geometry tool: position drift of non-intervened objects against the reload, and containment of frame-0 private-mask back-projections in the translated boxes
truth_box_source.plain_language_zh: 评价器和 S1-04 诊断要的真值整物体包围盒从来没写进私有面（逐帧只有 x/y/z）。裁决 45 定为：每条 episode 把 house 在模拟器里重载一次，读初始状态每个物体的轴对齐盒与朝向；之后每帧的盒子＝初始盒加上私有位姿记录的平移，坐标换到以观测 0 相机为原点的 episode 系。move/add 用 PlaceObjectAtPoint 执行、保持朝向，放置后的物理沉降登记为残差。把各可见帧反投影点并起来的「观测集合盒」只是代理量，只作对照列，不当真值。

private_truth_inputs.missing_objects: per removed or moved object: {old_centroid_m, old_place_observable_since_intervention: bool}
private_truth_inputs.carriers_before_move: per moved object: every entity id whose identity resolved to it at the last frame before the move
private_truth_inputs.derived_from: S0-02 private plane: instance_mask_path, object_id_to_entity_id, object_poses, intervention log; plus the per-episode object geometry table (S1-04, ruling 45) for the truth boxes
private_truth_inputs.plain_language_zh: 私有输入全部由 S0-02 的 private 面派生：色块的实例重叠表来自 instance mask，物体位置来自逐帧 object_poses，缺失物体与可观察性来自干预日志和公开可见体积。任何一项都不进入部署读取器。

fragment_dominance.no_instance_is_unlabelled: a fragment overlapping no private instance is unlabelled
fragment_dominance.two_or_more_instances_below_threshold_is: a fragment overlapping two or more instances whose top share is below dominance_min_share is identity_ambiguous
fragment_dominance.single_instance_below_threshold_is_unlab: a fragment overlapping one instance whose share is below dominance_min_share is mostly background and is unlabelled

existence.gone_rule: object absent from the scene, or its current centroid farther than delta_moved_m from the entity's remembered centroid

labels.plain_language_zh: 实体身份取其全部带物体证据的严格多数（超过一半），没有严格多数即身份含糊，不另设阈值；背景证据不投票。色块目标列的规则：先按实例重叠表判主导物体——没有物体记 unlabelled，覆盖两个及以上物体且最大占比低于阈值或并列记 identity_ambiguous，只覆盖一个物体但占比低于阈值记 unlabelled；主导物体成立后，记忆里没有这个物体记 birth，有但没被召回记 recall_miss，有且被召回则目标是它（重复实体取首版本最早、并列取 ID 最小的那个，若只有重复实体被召回则以被召回者为目标），这个物体的证据只落在身份含糊的实体里记 identity_ambiguous 而不是猜 birth。存在标签：物体不在场景中、或已离开实体记住的位置超过 delta_moved_m 即 gone，否则 present，身份含糊记 identity_ambiguous；候选状态只允许 active 与 dormant（S0-01 允许 RETRACT dormant；裁决 P），retracted 候选直接拒绝。以上口径由 D-224-LQ 裁决 N、P、Q 冻结。裁决 67（2026-09-24）冻结 dominance_min_share=0.5（严格多数，S1-04 标注用的就是过半规则）与 delta_moved_m=0.5（搬动下限 0.6 m 在其上、未干预物体漂移 1.4～16 cm 在其下）。 v2 新增 duplicate_of_labelled（裁决 X1，见 same_frame_duplicates）。

same_frame_duplicates.rule: among fragments of one frame that are labelled with the same dominant object and the same target entity, the fragment with the most pixels on that object keeps the target
same_frame_duplicates.plain_language_zh: SAM 常把一个物体切成几块（椅座和椅背）。若同一帧两块都判定为同一物体、目标又是同一个实体，执行器规定一个实体每帧只收一块，第二块无论如何都满足不了；把它记成 amortization error 是把结构性不可能算到学生头上。因此只有物体上像素最多的那块保留目标（并列取整块像素多者，再取 fragment_id 小者），其余记 duplicate_of_labelled：不进损失、不记任何错误类、单独计数（裁决 X1）。目标不同、目标是新建列、或 recall_miss 的色块不折叠，因为它们没有结构性冲突。复审修订（LOG-225）：记账时保留块和它的重复块按一组判，组内任一块分到了目标实体、且没有一块被绑到别的既有实体，保留块就记 correct；学生把物体绑到椅背而不是椅座，不再算错。
same_frame_duplicates.group_accounting: the keeper and its duplicates are judged as one group: the keeper counts as correct iff some member is assigned to the target entity and no member is bound to a different existing entity; duplicates are charged to no class

decomposition.recall_miss: the correct entity exists in memory but was not recalled; the student is not charged
decomposition.teacher_error: the label is unresolvable (fragment dominance or entity identity ambiguous); the decision is counted, not guessed
decomposition.amortization_error: the label is resolvable, the target was available, and the student still chose otherwise; includes false and missed retracts
decomposition.identity: recall_miss + teacher_error + amortization_error + correct + unlabelled + duplicate_of_labelled == fragments + existence candidates, checked on every frame
decomposition.plain_language_zh: 每帧记账，每一个决定恰好落入一类：正确实体没被召回是 recall miss，学生无从选起；标签本身含糊是 teacher error，只计数不猜；标签明确、候选也在、学生仍选错是 amortization error。未标注色块不算进任何错误但单独计数。五类之和必须等于决定总数，分配与标签、决定与候选的集合必须一一对应。 同帧重复色块与未标注色块一样不算进任何错误，单独计数（裁决 X1）。

metrics.house_aggregation: micro: sum of numerators over sum of denominators across the house's frames; recovery latency is the mean over recovered objects; contamination and size/cost are means over frames

node_prf1.numerator: matched pairs of an in-memory entity and a present truth object whose centroid distance is within delta_moved_m, under the evaluator's own maximum-weight matching with weight 1/(1+distance_m)
node_prf1.precision_denominator: entities whose state is in memory_present_states, minus entities that resolve to a present object outside the truth node scope; those are reported in out_of_scope_entities (an entity whose object is absent stays in and is stale)
node_prf1.recall_denominator: present truth objects in the truth node scope
node_prf1.structural_type_of_a_key: the private object key up to its first '|' (ProcTHOR's structural ids are wall|..., room|..., door|..., window|... and the room ceilings Ceiling_room|...)
node_prf1.structural_scope_plain_language_zh: 裁决 56 续：墙、房间（地面）、门、窗四类房屋结构件不进真值节点范围。一次只看到一段墙，而真值框是整面墙或整个房间，任何框或质心口径都匹配不上（S1-04 开发 cache 上占 IoU 行的 65%，墙的质心最近即自己只有 3%）。它们不是可干预、会移动的物体。解析到它们的实体照旧留在记忆里，按 X6 记为范围外，不进精确率分母；召回分母也不含它们。这改变了论文里“节点”的含义，方法与限制须写明。裁决 69（2026-09-24）把房间天花板 Ceiling_room 并入结构件清单：理由与四类相同，天花板是房屋结构、不可干预、一次只看到一片。
node_prf1.spawned_rule_plain_language_zh: 裁决 69：鸡蛋碎裂、面包切片这类物理事件在运行时生成的物体（私有键最后一段是"字母_数字"的生成标签，如 EggCracked_0）重载时不存在、没有初始盒，记在场、范围外、无盒并单独计数，不进节点指标；其它几何表以外的键仍整条 episode 失败（S2-01）。
node_prf1.truth_table: every private object any entity's evidence can resolve to, each with present, in_scope and (when present) box and centroid; the scope rule is applied by the evaluator, never by pre-filtering the table
node_prf1.primary_plain_language_zh: 裁决 72 (B)：主节点列回答“实体记在了对的地方吗”。仍在记忆里的实体与本帧在场、范围内的真值物体做评价器自带的最大权匹配，一对能配的条件是质心距离 ≤ 已冻结的 delta_moved_m（0.5 m），权重 1/(1+距离) 让更近的对先配。例如实体框只是椅子朝向相机的那层表面、质心离真值 0.2 m，算配上；停在 1.3 m 外旧位置的实体配不上。它是选参指标（裁决 V 的“节点 F1”），不进主门；与 Dyn-THOR 是同一匹配机制、不同重叠判定。

node_prf1_iou.numerator: matched pairs of an in-memory entity box and a present truth box with 3D AABB IoU >= iou_min, under the evaluator's own maximum-weight matching
node_prf1_iou.precision_denominator: identical to node_prf1 (the same prediction set, the same out_of_scope exclusion)
node_prf1_iou.recall_denominator: identical to node_prf1 (the same present in-scope truth objects)
node_prf1_iou.why: Ruling 72 (B), LOG-257 sequel: with perfect segmentation and perfect identity grouping the IoU-0.3 ceiling is 0.64 against 0.86 for the centroid rule; entity boxes are single-frame depth-surface shells and truth boxes whole objects, so this column mostly measures that geometric gap. Kept as the Dyn-THOR original overlap test (ruling C), reported beside the primary column.
node_prf1_iou.plain_language_zh: 次级节点列回答“框重叠够吗”：同一批预测实体、同一批真值物体、同一个匹配器，重叠判定是 3D AABB IoU ≥ 0.3（裁决 C 的原主列），即 Dyn-THOR 原口径的数值。实体框是单帧深度表面壳、真值是整体盒，这一列天然偏低，只并列报告，不选配置、不进主门。

missing_residual_rate.numerator: removed or moved objects with an in-memory entity of that identity within delta_moved_m of the old position
missing_residual_rate.denominator: removed or moved objects whose old place has been observable to the method since the intervention
missing_residual_rate.headline_time: episode end; the per-frame series is diagnostic, not a separate metric

false_retract_rate.numerator: RETRACT decisions whose existence label is present
false_retract_rate.denominator: RETRACT decisions with a resolvable existence label
false_retract_rate.ambiguous: RETRACT decisions on identity-ambiguous entities are counted, not judged
false_retract_rate.not_applicable: arms whose vocabulary lacks RETRACT report not_applicable; they enter neither the exclusion list nor any pairing on this metric

identity_continuity.numerator: moved objects whose fragment at the first labelled re-observation after the move is assigned to any entity that carried the object before the move
identity_continuity.denominator: moved objects re-observed with a label after the move that had at least one carrier before the move
identity_continuity.no_prior_carrier: moved objects never carried before the move are excluded and counted

recovery_latency_frames.end: first frame at which the memory state for the object is correct
recovery_latency_frames.correct_state: removed: no in-memory entity of that identity within delta_moved_m of the old position; added: one within delta_moved_m of the new position; moved: both conditions
recovery_latency_frames.never_observable: objects whose intervened place is never observable are listed, not averaged

contamination_auc.series: per frame: (stale in-memory entities + wrongly absent truth objects) / (in-memory entities + wrongly absent truth objects)
contamination_auc.stale: an in-memory entity whose resolved object is absent or farther than delta_moved_m from the entity's remembered centroid
contamination_auc.wrongly_absent: a present truth object in scope with no in-memory entity of that identity within delta_moved_m of its position

size_and_cost.active_entity_count: entities in state active after the frame commits
size_and_cost.runtime_per_frame_s: wall-clock seconds of the method's per-frame call, excluding the shared frontend
size_and_cost.peak_memory_bytes: peak resident memory of the method process over the episode
size_and_cost.lifecycle_version_count: versions across all entities, including retracted ones, whose opened_by is not in lifecycle_version_excludes (birth, retract, reactivate, dormant and dedup count; bind does not)

metrics.plain_language_zh: 七项指标分项报告，不合成单一总分，清单外的不得计算或报告。以下口径由 D-224-LQ 裁决 L～Q 冻结：dormant 实体算“仍在记忆里”，在节点 P/R/F1 里进预测集合、在 Missing 残留率里算残留，因为 dormancy 是无证据的共享规则，不能当作正确的“不在”判断记功；身份连续率在搬动后第一次带标签重见时按当时的分配判定，不承认此后共享去重的 canonical_of 折叠；恢复延迟从干预处第一次对方法可观察的帧起算，而不是从干预发生的帧起算；未恢复与从未可观察的物体单独列出，不进平均。节点匹配是评价器自己写的最大权匹配，故意不复用方法的分配求解器，且不读任何表面 ID。交并比下限 0.3 由 D-224 裁决 C 冻结，不是待调数值。 v2：规模指标里的“历史版本数”改为生命周期版本数，不数 BIND 打开的逐观察版本，否则它约等于观察次数（裁决 X6）；评价器匹配改为按非零 IoU 的连通块分别求解，匹配数与总权重与整张矩阵求解相同（裁决 X5）；真值表带 in_scope 标志，范围规则由评价器套用（裁决 X6）。

statistics.resampling: house-level paired bootstrap with a registered seed
statistics.main_gate_rule: one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired advantage of VSMT-lean over the strongest control must exceed 0 on both metrics
statistics.ablation_rule: each ablation is compared with VSMT-lean by the same paired bootstrap and reported as a lower bound; ablations never enter the main gate; AssocOnly is the causal counterfactual of contribution one and must sit in the main table next to the four controls
statistics.plain_language_zh: 统计以 house 为配对与重采样单位，bootstrap 10,000 次、单侧 95% 下界由 METHOD 第十一节冻结；seed 与效应量在 S3-01 冻结，当前为 null。主门是 VSMT-lean 相对最强对照在 Missing 残留率（越低越好）和身份连续率（越高越好）两项的单侧 95% 下界都大于零；最强对照按该指标在同一划分上的 house 均值逐指标选取。四组消融与 VSMT-lean 用同一配对 bootstrap 比较并报告下界，不设门；AssocOnly 必须与四个对照并列进主表。LLM-op 只在 validation 上跑、只进附录、不进 test。某个 house 缺任一臂即拒绝，不悄悄跳过。test 只读一次。 某个 house 在某项指标上没法算（例如没有一件被搬走后重访过的物体，值为 null）时，该 house 在该指标上对所有臂一并排除、报告有效 house 数，绝不填 0 或 1；S3-01 的功效预算按有效数算（裁决 X2）。复审修订（LOG-225）：按构造没法算的臂不参与排除清单，例如从不撤回的 TAF、LOW、AssocOnly 之于假撤回率，它们在这项上报不适用；否则每个 house 都会被排除，整列对谁都报不出来。
statistics.undefined_house_rule: a house whose value is null for any applicable reported arm on a metric is excluded from that metric's pairing for every arm; the exclusion list is computed once per metric over the applicable reported arms, passed to every bootstrap and to the strongest-control selection, and the effective house count is reported; null is never imputed. An arm for which the metric is not applicable by construction (metric_not_applicable_rule) reports not_applicable and enters neither the exclusion list nor any pairing on that metric
statistics.strongest_control_evaluated_on: the split of the comparison over the same effective houses; on test this is a post hoc maximum over the four controls and is therefore conservative for the method

nuisance_probe.method: leave-one-out majority label per field value versus global majority, every field against every label kind
nuisance_probe.scope: judged_over_the_pooled_rows_of_one_split; the per_episode largest_advantage is reported and never judged
nuisance_probe.plain_language_zh: 只用路径、seed、帧号、house 序号去猜三种标签（色块目标状态、目标是否为新建列、存在标签），留一法准确率不得明显高于只猜多数类的准确率。例如帧号能猜出撤回标签，说明干预总在固定帧发生。允许的最大优势待冻结，当前为 null。裁决 68（2026-09-25，LOG-256 续）冻结上限 0.05，并登记 scope：门槛只对一个 split 全部 episode 合并后的行判定，逐 episode 的 largest_advantage 只报告不判定。依据：路径、seed、house 序号在单条 episode 内恒定、优势恒为 0，只有跨 house 合并后才有区分力，也才是探针要抓的身份泄漏；而 frame_index 在单条 episode 内的优势最高 0.128（00406）——同一帧的色块状态成簇（新物体入镜的帧多 birth、去重帧多 duplicate），是时间聚类不是泄漏。

user_rulings.L: dormant entities count as in memory for node P/R/F1 and MRR
user_rulings.M: identity continuity judged at the first labelled re-observation by the assignment; canonical_of folding not recognised
user_rulings.N: fragment dominance over all fragment pixels, two-or-more instances below threshold or tied is ambiguous; entity identity is a strict majority with no second threshold
user_rulings.O: recovery latency starts at the first frame the intervened place is observable to the method
user_rulings.P: existence candidates are active and dormant; retracted is rejected
user_rulings.Q: truth nodes are present objects observable at least once since episode start; displacement is measured from the entity's remembered centroid
user_rulings.plain_language_zh: 六项口径由用户于 2026-09-20 以 D-224-LQ 批准，全部按 LOG-217 的推荐口径执行；本合同的状态集合、规则字符串与布尔声称即其机器形式。
user_rulings.ruling_56_continued: the truth node scope excludes the four ProcTHOR structural types door, room, wall and window, identified by the private key prefix; entities resolving to them are out of scope under X6 (D-224-S1 ruling 56 continued, 2026-09-24, 原话「裁决 56 续取 (a)：真值范围排除 wall/room/door/window，BIND 框改为同帧并集；裁决 58 取 1.0 m」; evidence LOG-244 continued)
user_rulings.ruling_67: D-224-S1 裁决 67（2026-09-24 批准，原话「S2-05 审过；裁决 67 八个值全按推荐。」）：labels.fragment_dominance.dominance_min_share=0.5、labels.existence.delta_moved_m=0.5，绑定常量 DOMINANCE_MIN_SHARE／DELTA_MOVED_M，登记进跨合同台账；bootstrap_seed 与 main_gate_effect_size 留到 S3-01，nuisance 上限归裁决 68。
user_rulings.ruling_69: D-224-S1 裁决 69（2026-09-24 批准，原话「裁决 69 取 (a)。」，取 (a)）：structural_types_excluded_from_scope 加 Ceiling_room；新增 spawned_after_reload_rule。这是规则变更，规则摘要重钉（见跨合同台账）。S1 不重做。
user_rulings.ruling_70: D-224-S1 裁决 70（2026-09-24 批准，原话「裁决 70 取 (a)」）：主节点指标保持裁决 C 的匈牙利 3D IoU 0.3 不变；新增 node_prf1_centroid 次级列——同一批预测、同一批真值、同一个评价器匹配器，重叠判定换成实体质心到真值质心距离 ≤ delta_moved_m（0.5 m），权重 1/(1+距离)；主表并列报告，不选配置、不进主门。依据 LOG-255 的只读审计。
user_rulings.ruling_68: D-224-S1 裁决 68（2026-09-25 批准，原话「裁决 68 全按推荐」）：nuisance_probe.maximum_advantage=0.05，绑定常量 NUISANCE_MAXIMUM_ADVANTAGE，登记进跨合同台账；新增规则字串 nuisance_probe.scope（split 级判定，逐 episode 只报告），绑定 NUISANCE_SCOPE_RULE，规则摘要重钉；bootstrap_seed 与 main_gate_effect_size 留到 S3-01。
user_rulings.ruling_72: D-224-S1 裁决 72 (B)（2026-09-25 16:35 CST 批准，原话「裁决 72 取 (A)(a)(B)(a)(C)(a)(D)(a)」）：裁决 70 改取 (b)。node_prf1 的匹配改为质心 ≤ delta_moved_m、权重 1/(1+距离)（主列、选参指标，不进主门）；原 IoU 0.3 匹配改名 node_prf1_iou（次级列，不选配置、不进主门），node_prf1_centroid 取消。两列同一预测集合、同一真值集合、同一评价器匹配器，只换重叠判定；与 Dyn-THOR 是“同一匹配机制、不同重叠判定”，论文须写明。依据：LOG-257 续——完美分割＋完美身份合并时 IoU 0.3 上界 0.64、质心 0.86，IoU 列主要量的是单帧深度表面壳对整体盒的几何差而非记忆对错。发生在任何 validation/test 数据生成之前；开发 cache 是 train 划分。

continue_gate.plain_language_zh: S0-04 的继续门是：指标清单在任何数据生成前冻结、清单外指标不得计算或报告；私有数据只能凭两段封存回执打开；每个标签要么可判要么被计数；评价器的匹配独立于方法求解器并与暴力枚举比对过；合同里的每一个布尔声称都被校验器绑定。检查通过不等于指标有区分度，也不等于数值合适。
